correctness.rationale: Klimov 2026 classifies finite periodic UFS-magmas as order-two de Bruijn cycles. A magma automorphism commutes with a single n^2-cycle on pairs and hence acts as a cyclic shift; nonidentity automorphisms act freely on symbols. Quotient complete digraph voltage sum m^2*d(d-1)/2 mod d must equal one, forcing d=2 and m odd. Conversely an Euler circuit of doubled complete digraph on m odd orbits lifts twice to a de Bruijn cycle with phase-flip symmetry, so Aut=C2. Read RESULT.md and verify.py; n=2 cycle and n=3,4 brute-force compatibility checked by package code inspection and independent algebra; full infinitary n statement is proved by quotient argument, not enumeration.
